grammar: UNMODIFIED_G_cog = {Pi,X,C,Q,P_in,P_out,K,T,rho/O}; frozen S interpreted as X, no new action-sequence coordinator primitive

layers.L_sys: Flat MB/MF & source-value combiner; hierarchical source-level GD selector, learned option repertoire and source-defined execution/progress.
layers.L_claim: Source assertions distinct from evidence, fit claims and unresolved code assumptions.
layers.L_ctx: Two-stage fixed-key experiment, participant samples, reward/reset regimes and task-specific limits.
layers.L_formal: Original eq2-15 plus one explicit researcher-only eq10 denominator index normalization; source eq13 exact index binding unresolved.

role_mapping.source_bounded_content: Separate flat MB/MF, compared architecture families, option versus single choices, active versus fresh stage-two action. These are nested partitions of source-described mechanism, not extra entities.

Flat: current learned T2, QH(stage/action), parameters, perseveration context. Hierarchy: learned transitions for single/sequence options; source-defined selected option and execution progress until completion; no extra supervisory state.

Admissible S0 options 2 singles+4 sequences, per-state eligible actions; eq7 restricted second-stage trigger, reduced-variant parameter equalities, open-loop scheduled next action; distinguish from experimental preparation.
Expected terminal reward drives MB/option evaluation; flat w-valued mixture and softmax; hierarchy option-kind weights w/1-w and normalized choice eq10 are existing source criteria.
Selected individual motor action goes to World, including next predetermined element when active option receives expected stimulus; experimental manipulations of task schedule belong E_exp, not P_in.
Observed slot-machine stimulus and terminal reward enter at appropriate stage; during active sequence the expected stimulus may launch next action without fresh reward-based stepwise arbitration.

Source MB Bellman/transition update, MF TD/eligibility, flat eq8 stateless combiner, hierarchy option valuation/softmax, option-conditioned stage-two mixture and post-terminal learning. External state transitions are not K.

Decision before first action; World transition precedes stage-two stimulus; active option may produce preset second action; terminal feedback precedes next learned-dependent choice. C04 does not artificially total-order abstract handoff vs internal learning.

The agent-accessible state signal, outcome observations, and researcher-measured choice/RT are distinguished. Experimentally recorded RT is not automatically an agent P_out available to its own policy.

architectures.original_control: Flat source-defined MF/MB values are combined using eq8 w weighting; then eq9 softmax with state-specific beta and k perseveration occurs at each stage. No hidden requirement that first-stage control fix stage-two action.

mapping.X: learned first/second-stage QH and learned stage-two T; MB value and action-perseveration context
mapping.Pi: MB vs MF source components and action per stage
mapping.C: two actions available per S0/S1/S2; eq7 eligibility condition; original eight nested parameter configurations
mapping.K: eq2-7 learning + Bellman + eq8 mixing + eq9 choice
mapping.P_out: state/reward observations after each World transition
mapping.rho/O: measured trial actions, state and terminal reward as appropriate boundary projections

coordination.A0: FULL_SOURCE_LEVEL_DIRECT: eq8 is an EXISTING source comparator/combiner; no separately invented coordination process required
coordination.A1: NOT_NECESSARY_AS_ADDITION: explicit source eq8 is already a typed value-combining interface; code may implement stateless adapters but these are implementation choices, not newly inferred mechanism
coordination.A2: NOT_REQUIRED: do not invent extra persistent coordination state or reclassify original source's flat arbiter as an inferred A2.

architectures.original_negative: Original Fig5 changed-machine conditional pattern not captured by fitted flat family; this is original comparative finding, not generic impossibility for every alternative flat model.

architectures.original_control: Goal-directed evaluates a single action or full 2-step sequence in S0. A source-defined active sequence has its own next-action identity and completion semantics; it receives expected stimulus to launch next action but need not query new reward/perform fresh arbitration mid-sequence. Source discussion allows GD inhibition; fitted stochastic equations do not specify an additional stop-state model.

mapping.X: learned transitions for singles/compound options, selected option identity and progress index (source-defined episode memory), perseveration
mapping.Pi: single vs two-step option identities and latent cause of first action
mapping.C: six source-enumerated S0 options; expected stimulus trigger; sequence completion; no new supervisory entity
mapping.Q: goal-directed option value via eq3/4, option-kind weights omega and perseveration in normalized eq10
mapping.K: eq2 option/single post-terminal update, original eq3 option value, eq10 normalized selection, eq11/12 latent option conditioning, source-qualified eq13 stage-two mixture
mapping.P_in: first selected physical action followed by predetermined second physical action if active; singleton causes fresh second decision
mapping.P_out: expected stage-two state trigger and post-terminal outcome with different causal roles
mapping.T: option selection < first physical step < external state transition/stimulus < second physical step/override < terminal outcome < next choice
mapping.rho/O: conditional second-stage choices, RT and realized rewards measured at boundary

coordination.A0: FULL_AT_SOURCE_STRUCTURAL_LEVEL_WITH_NOTATION_EXCEPTION: author-original goal-directed option selector plus its authored option execution state directly realizes hierarchy; no extra invented coordinator.
coordination.A1: NOT_NECESSARY_BEYOND_SOURCE_INTERFACES: typed stage-boundary trigger and option-progress representation are already implicit/explicit in original options; an adapter is a code-interface if used, not newly discovered cognitive mechanism.
coordination.A2: NOT_REQUIRED_BY_THIS_SOURCE: added persistent central coordinator would double count source's existing option-selection and episode-execution state; other untested mechanisms remain possible.

architectures.original_negative: Source-disabled eq15 family reduces second-stage model fit; conceptually feedback-responsive hierarchy may show flat-like second-stage predictions; source does not falsify all MF or parallel processes.

distinct_objects: World W physical task states and reward stochasticity
E_exp externally imposed protocol and reward resets
formal: O_t = rho_Pi(W_t, Gamma_in, E_exp, t)  (agent-facing state/expected next-step signal; empirical RT separately projected)
u_t = P_in(Policy_QC(X_t, O_t))  (flat single action each stage OR source-defined hierarchical chosen option's next physical step)
W_(t+1) = F_W(W_t, Gamma_out(u_t), E_exp,t, xi_t)  (external 70/30 transition and reward process, NOT internal K)
X_(t+1) = K_C(X_t, P_out(O_(t+1)), terminal_feedback_if_any, active_option_if_any) (typed internal transitions and source terminal updates)
R = (O_0, u_0, W_1, O_1, u_1, terminal_reward, ...)  (realized history, not identical to model state or experimental preparation)
recurrence.event_guard: For active 2-step option, expected state signal triggers stored second action without recomputing its identity from intermediate reward; if source-described inhibition occurs, treat as conceptual alternative not a fitted stop-hazard parameter.
recurrence.world_initial_conditions: World five states and task reward/reset schedule sit in W and E_exp; admissible cognitive configurations C do not literally encode experimenter's condition.

source_exceptions.effect: 2013 actual fit code equivalence to normalized eq10 unverified; numerical replication and historical likelihood unsupported.
Eq13 exact generic printed coefficient binding unresolved; only mechanistic mixture reconstructed from prose+eq11-12.

coordination_conclusion: Both architectures can be reconstructed A0 using their OWN source-declared mechanisms; different comparators remain distinct; neither forces extra A1 or A2. This is paper-relative not universal.
